An '''Officer of Defense''' was a person tasked with defending a particular location, particular a [[City/Legends|city]], from potential threats. [[Victor Visalis]] was the Office of Defense for [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] during [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
